categories.main_business_segments: FINDEX Inc. operates three main business segments: Medical Business, Public Business, and Healthtech Business. The Medical Business focuses on the development and sale of medical systems and devices for healthcare institutions. The Public Business provides document management and electronic approval systems for public sector organizations. The Healthtech Business develops and sells innovative medical devices, such as gaze analysis perimeters for vision testing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced software development, cloud computing, AI (including generative AI for medical documentation), and medical device engineering. Key technologies include electronic medical records, document management, image filing, and gaze analysis algorithms for vision testing. Production involves both in-house R&D and collaborations with universities and research institutions, with a strong emphasis on proprietary logic and patented systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: FINDEX primarily serves hospitals, clinics, and other healthcare providers, as well as local governments and public sector organizations. Its end markets include the Japanese healthcare system, public administration, and, increasingly, overseas medical institutions through its Healthtech products. The company also targets health screening facilities and research organizations.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations are mainly concentrated in Japan, with headquarters in Tokyo and multiple regional offices nationwide. It has begun expanding internationally, particularly in the EU, where it started selling its gaze analysis perimeter device. Over 90% of revenue is still generated from domestic customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: FINDEX operates primarily as a downstream solution provider, delivering finished software products, cloud services, and medical devices directly to end users such as hospitals, clinics, and public sector entities. It also collaborates with sales partners and distributors for broader market reach.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating digital transformation (DX) in healthcare and public sectors, expanding cloud-based and AI-driven solutions, and promoting overseas growth for medical devices. R&D focuses on next-generation medical information infrastructure, AI-powered documentation, and innovative diagnostic devices, with ongoing investment in proprietary technologies and patents. The company also emphasizes sustainability, diversity, and robust information security.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through a mix of software license sales, cloud service subscriptions, hardware (medical device) sales, and ongoing support/maintenance contracts. Public sector solutions increasingly use a recurring, subscription-based model. Custom development and consulting services provide additional revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the medical IT and public sector DX markets, FINDEX faces limited direct competition in its core niches, especially in public document management. In Healthtech, its gaze analysis device competes with both domestic and international firms, but FINDEX differentiates itself through proprietary logic and unique features. The company positions itself as an innovative, high-quality solution provider with strong R&D capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending December 2024, consolidated sales reached approximately 5.84 billion yen, with operating profit of 1.53 billion yen and net profit attributable to shareholders of 1.16 billion yen. The company has demonstrated steady growth, with a 12.5% year-on-year increase in sales and a solid financial base (equity ratio over 80%). Employee count is over 300, and the company maintains a strong cash position despite increased R&D and investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: FINDEX emphasizes high-quality, innovative solutions tailored to the evolving needs of healthcare and public sector clients. Its unique value lies in proprietary technologies, rapid product development, and strong integration capabilities. The company’s Healthtech products, such as the GAP gaze analyzer, offer distinctive diagnostic logic not replicated by competitors, while its cloud and AI solutions enhance operational efficiency and compliance for clients.
